astrometric_companions.primary_selection: parallax between 0.5 and 0.98 and parallax_over_error>15 and phot_g_mean_mag<16.5 and pm>10 and ruwe<1.4 and abs(b)>30 and ra between 0 and 5 and dec between -60 and -40
astrometric_companions.caveat: All sources were already Gaia-catalogued; only associations could be new. Selection outside El-Badry 2021 parallax >1 mas scope is deliberate, not evidence of novelty.
astrometric_companions.positive_controls: El-Badry exact pair, Tian exact pair, SUPERWIDE high- and low-parallax-error tables, WDS same cone endpoint, SIMBAD same cone endpoint, and known 4.826 arcsec Gaia pair measurement all recovered
astrometric_companions.monte_carlo_caveat: 20,000 independent-source Gaussian draws with Gaia within-source parallax/PM covariance plus 0.02 mas and 0.03 mas/yr floors. Quantiles propagate measurement error only; no radial velocities, line-of-sight separation or binding prior.
astrometric_companions.poisson_control_interpretation: Zero matches in 12,309 shifted-primary trials. A homogeneous independent Poisson model gives 95% upper expectation approximately one accidental passing directed pair in the 4,103-primary native sample; Galactic correlations and mismatched position systematics limit that approximation. It is not an individual binding probability.

field543.caveat: Control includes real binaries and selection effects; scatter is not a calibrated survey false-alarm model.

field469.caveat: Control includes real binaries and selection effects; scatter is not a calibrated survey false-alarm model.

conclusion: No previously unknown/uncatalogued star established. Two cleaner possible unreported associations and two provisional RV leads remain among already catalogued stars.
counting_caveat: Tracks overlap and have different selection units; do not add their star/peak/catalog-query counts into a claimed independent survey total.
